lastSummary: NC-013 fixed: Model fallback is now explicit and user-controlled. (1) Added FallbackCandidate interface and CandidateFailure type for structured fallback configuration and error reporting. (2) ModelRouterConfig.fallbackCandidates (optional, default empty) defines ordered cross-provider fallback — empty by default means no cross-provider fallback occurs (NC-001/NC-013 containment). (3) resolveCandidates() now appends fallback candidates after same-provider explicit+default, with deduplication and missing-provider skipping. (4) generate() and stream() track per-candidate failures (provider, model, error, HTTP status code) in CandidateFailure[] instead of silently discarding. (5) buildFinalError() produces detailed error messages listing every candidate tried with per-candidate reasons, HTTP status codes, and category-specific troubleshooting. (6) FallbackCandidate and CandidateFailure exported from agent-core barrel. (7) 29 regression tests in modelFallback.test.ts: resolveCandidates (11 tests), generate error reporting (8 tests), stream error reporting (3 tests), backward compatibility (3 tests), edge cases (4 tests). 1139/1140 tests pass (1 pre-existing failure in approvalPolicy.test.ts). Build clean. All type-checks clean.
